_doc: Phase 12 D3 (#389) — the empty-state catalog. Every list, panel and chart in the game that can have nothing to show draws its sentence from here. A region with nothing in it is the surface a new player meets FIRST, and a blank box is indistinguishable from a broken one, so each of these says what is missing AND what the player can do about it.
_copyDoc: `text` is player-facing copy and lives HERE, never as a literal in a component — tests/EmptyStates.test.tsx scans src/ for it, the same guard tests/HintCopy.test.ts puts on hint copy. It obeys the .claude/rules/ui.md plain-language rule: plain words a layperson reads right on the first pass, and never a temperature word. Every entry is a full sentence naming a next action; tests/PlainLanguage.test.tsx enforces both. An entry that states a tier gate is naming a real next action, not apologizing for a missing feature.
_slotDoc: A `{slot}` is filled by the caller through `emptyState(id, slots)`. An unfilled slot is left literal, the industry-wire rule — a missing fill shows up as a visibly wrong sentence rather than a silently truncated one. Three exist: {department} on the People roster panels, {queue} on a department queue screen, and {spaces} on the auction's capacity notice.
_sharedDoc: Some ids are drawn from two places on purpose — the same region reachable from two rooms. `demand_readout` is Home's market band and Growth's demand console; `lot_no_spaces` is the Lot's sourcing block and the auction's bidding notice; `parts_coverage` is Service and the Body Shop; `gate_trend` is the Home gate strip and the Growth gate board; `no_saved_games` is the main menu and the in-game load list. Splitting one of these gives the player two wordings of one fact and two entries that can drift.
